storeys.instructions: How many full street-facing storeys does the house front in the middle of `facade` have? Count the ground storey once however tall it is, then each full storey above it up to the cornice line or the foot of the gable. Do NOT count: a souterrain (a half-sunk basement with windows at knee height, usually under a stoop), an entresol or mezzanine inside a tall ground storey, windows in the gable or crown, dormers or roof windows, or a set-back attic storey. A bel-etage above a souterrain is the first storey.

criteria.one: one full storey (the ground storey only)
